# Know Your Meme

> > The definitive encyclopedia of internet culture, memes, viral trends, and online phenomena.

Know Your Meme documents and explains viral memes, TikTok trends, internet slang, and social media phenomena across platforms like Twitter/X, Reddit, Facebook, and YouTube. The site provides detailed guides, origin stories, and cultural context for understanding modern internet culture.

## Key Topics

- TikTok trends
- Viral memes
- Internet slang
- Exploitable memes
- Image macros
- Catchphrases
- Viral videos
- Twitter/X culture
- Reddit communities
- Dance memes
- YouTube phenomena
- Facebook sharing
- DeviantArt culture
- Nostalgia memes
- Social media trends

## Viral TikTok Trends

- [I'm Talking About Innit | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/im-talking-about-innit): TikTok dance trend based on BunnaB & YKNiece's Atlanta rap song 'Innit'
- [How About A Nice Big Cup of Shut the Fuck Up | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/how-about-a-nice-big-cup-of-shut-the-fuck-up): WWII poster-based catchphrase meme trending on TikTok with lip-dubs
- [Millennial Burger Place | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/millennial-burger-place): TikTok trend mocking cliché millennial burger restaurant aesthetics

## Exploitable Meme Formats

- [We Still Talk About You | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/we-still-talk-about-you): Exploitable meme featuring girl & cat art, viral on TikTok & Twitter
- [Jesse, What the Fuck Are You Talking About | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/jesse-what-the-fuck-are-you-talking-about): Breaking Bad dialogue meme featuring Walter White & Jesse Pinkman confusion
